page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 8 vCPUs and 4 physical cores. It features x86_64 architecture, a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz, and a 33 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 31.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.88 GB per core. For acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the CPU performance is modest, with stress-ng and Geekbench scores falling into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% brackets respectively. However, the system shows average performance in uncached memory read and write bandwidth, reaching 39.4 GB/sec and 36.26 GB/sec. The primary strength of this instance lies in its GPU-driven LLM inference capabilities. It achieves top-tier performance in prompt processing for both small and medium models, processing 8407.18 and 1134.43 tokens per second respectively. Text generation for medium models is also strong, reaching 33.96 tokens per second.

Given the older Intel Xeon CPU architecture and modest general-purpose compute scores, this instance represents a cost-effective entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads rather than heavy CPU-bound tasks. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff. The instance is highly suited for low-to-medium scale deep learning inference, small-to-medium LLM deployment, and basic GPU-accelerated parallel processing tasks where high-end, expensive accelerators are not economically justified.
